infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for Oasis concerts
infoLinks.content:
From 7pm Thursday 6 November to 3am Sunday 9 November, routes 525 and 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Oasis Live '25 concerts. 
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.  
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Oasis Live ’25 event page for more details.

infoLinks.urlText: Cremorne Point Ferry Wharf temporary closure for maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Monday 26 May to Friday 12 December
  • Cremorne Point Ferry Wharf will temporarily close for essential maintenance works, including the replacement of the existing gangway and the installation of a new pontoon roof.
Alternative transport options include:
  • Old Cremorne Wharf
  • bus route 225 from Milsons Road Bus stop (Cremorne Point 209035)
  • bus route B1 from Military Rd for services to the city.
Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

urlText: Glebe bus diversions for Sydney Streets event
content:
From 7am to 11:30pm on Saturday 15 November, route 370, 431 and 433 services will be diverting and missing stops while road closures are in place for the City of Sydney’s Sydney Streets event along Glebe Point Rd in Glebe.
 
Buses will be diverting around Glebe Point Rd via St Johns Rd, Mount Vernon St, Catherine St and Derwent St.
 
Stops on Glebe Point Rd between St Johns Rd and Broadway will be missed in both directions.
 
Use alternative stops further along Glebe Point Rd, City Rd or Broadway and continue on foot. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. 
 
Missed and alternative stops:
  • Glebe Point Rd at Mitchell St (Stop ID 203726)
    • Alternative stop at Glebe Point Rd at St Johns Rd (Stop ID 203725)
  • Glebe Point Rd opp Glebe Public School (Stop ID 203727)
    • Alternative stop at Catherine St at Derwent St (Stop ID 203762)
  • Glebe Point Rd at Broadway (Stop ID 203728) (Route 370 only)
    • Alternative stop at City Rd opp Victoria Park (Stop ID 205040)
  • Glebe Point Rd at Broadway (Stop ID 203728)  (Route 431, 433 only)
    • Alternative stop at Parramatta Rd opp Victoria Park (Stop ID 203770)
  • Glebe Point Rd after Parramatta Rd (Stop ID 203729)
    • Alternative stop at Derwent St at Arundel St (Stop ID 203763)
  • Glebe Public School, Glebe Point Rd (Stop ID 203730)
    • Alternative stop at Derwent St at Arundel St (Stop ID 203763)
  • Glebe Point Rd at Mitchell St (Stop ID 203731)
    • Alternative stop at Catherine St opp Mitchell St (Stop ID 203764)
  • Glebe Point Rd at St Johns Rd (Stop ID 203732)
    • Alternative stop at Glebe Point Rd before Bridge Rd (Stop ID 203733)
subtitle: Glebe bus diversions for Sydney Streets event

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for Oasis concerts
infoLinks.content:

  • School routes 665s, 760s and 761s services will divert from 7am to 8.30am and from 3pm to 4.15pm, while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Oasis Live '25 concerts.
  • Services in both directions will divert via Edwin Flack Avenue and Sarah Durack Avenue to return to route on Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the other stops along Edwin Flack Avenue or Australia Avenue instead.
  • Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Oasis Live ’25 event page for more details.

infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for Oasis Live ’25 concerts at Olympic Park
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run for Oasis Live ‘25 concerts at Accor Stadium on Friday 7 and Saturday 8 November.  
 
Travel on Major Event Buses is included in the cost of your event ticket and services will run frequently. Attendees do not need to tap on and off, simply show your concert ticket to the driver when boarding buses.  
 
Please note that permanent bus stop closures on Major Event Bus Routes 2, 6 and 7 are now in effect (since 7 November) to improve service reliability and reduce wait times. Some stops in Glebe, Miranda, Caringbah, South Hurstville and Bankstown are permanently closed and replaced by alternative stops a short walk away. Check signage at bus stops for wayfinding maps to find the alternative stop.   
 
For more information visit the Oasis Live ’25 event page.
